title: ElevenLabs Conversation Analysis: Success Evaluation + Data
desc:
Every ElevenLabs agent conversation can be graded and mined automatically. This episode explains the four analysis capabilities, how success evaluation criteria return success, failure or unknown with a rationale, how to write good criteria, the four data collection types, the per-agent limits, example extraction prompts, and where the results go: call history, post-call webhooks, analytics and Spotlight.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
